The scalar grid-RMST statistic needs only its own asymptotic variance bounded away from zero; no other direction of the joint covariance must be nondegenerate. The condition is retained as an additional primitive learner-path restriction, not as a consequence of generic event consistency or product-rate bookkeeping. Proposition~\ref{prop:finite-stratum-hazard-certificate} separately proves attainability on a finite-stratum empirical-hazard submodel.
